name: Great Britain
_bounds: Header bbox of the Geofabrik great-britain extract (2026-08-30), which reaches well out to sea; the basemap built from the same extract shares it. Ireland is a separate extract and so a separate source.
_countries: Checked against valhalla/admins.sqlite before the build starts: a country with no polygon there gets Valhalla's default admin, which drives on the left.
_inputs: Britain drives on the left, which is entirely a property of admins.sqlite: without it every roundabout here is numbered off the wrong side of the road. It is the same continent-wide database the server routes from (infrastructure/valhalla/build-admins.sh), which is why it is required rather than merely nice.
_regions: Scotland is the first pack cut outside Norway. The box takes the Hebrides, Orkney and Shetland with the mainland, and stops short of the English border cities.
